papers.title: Where Do Vision Language Models Fail at 3D Reasoning?
papers.summary: Vision-language models often judge 3D object properties correctly but fail to recover and consistently apply exact per-color counts, motivating evaluation by exact correctness, consistency, and visual dependence.

papers.title: SWE-Trail: History-Guided Trajectory Collection for Coding Agent Training
papers.summary: SWE-Trail improves trajectory collection for coding agents by using past rollouts to guide exploration without exposing history to the agent, yielding better-trained student models.

papers.title: LEANGUARD: Lean-Verified Guardrails for Tool-Using Agents
papers.summary: LeanGuard is a verified runtime that blocks policy-violating tool calls by language-model agents and can repair them via proof-guided search, reducing unauthorized executions and prompt-injection success without harming benign task performance.

papers.title: Advances in Agentic Computer Graphics
papers.summary: This report proposes a unified taxonomy and literature system for agentic computer graphics driven by large language models, analyzing trends and open challenges in human-agent collaboration and long-horizon planning.

papers.title: When Does Latent Prediction Error Support Physical Surprise Claims in Video World Models?
papers.summary: The study evaluates frozen video representations to show that prediction errors reflect appearance and motion rather than reliably measuring physical surprise.
